takeaways.big_swing: Games turn in one place. When you next lose, find the moment rather than the move.
takeaways.atari_ignored: Look at your own groups every move. Any of them on one liberty?
takeaways.capture_missed: A group on one liberty is free. Take it before you go and do something clever.
takeaways.died_savable: A group in trouble wants more room, not more stones.
takeaways.own_eye_filled: A group needs two eyes to live. Never fill your own.
takeaways.self_atari: Count the liberties of the stone you are about to play, not just the ones you already have.
takeaways.dead_group_fed: When a group is dead, stop paying for it. Every extra stone is a second prisoner.
takeaways.filled_own_territory: Your own territory is already yours. Filling it in gives the points back.
takeaways.cut_ignored: When they play between two of your groups, answer there first.
takeaways.ladder_failed: Read a ladder to the edge of the board before you start running. It takes ten seconds.
takeaways.should_have_passed: Passing is a move. When there is nothing left worth a stone, count and pass.
